title: Decision tree and CNF representations agree
statement: Let $T$ be a decision tree on the binary cube with leaves labeled by signs in $\{ -1,1\}$. The Boolean function represented by the CNF formula associated with $T$ agrees at every sign-cube input with the function obtained by converting that input to binary coordinates, evaluating $T$, and converting its output to a sign.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on the binary cube with sign-valued leaves
